English Language.question:
১) Which of the following options is correct?
Trisha unnecessarily ____ a quarrel with Aurthy and left the party hurried.
English Language.exp: And দ্বারা যুক্ত দুটি বাক্যেরই Subject হল Trisha। এপাশে যেহেতু past Indefinite form, ওপাশেও তাই Past Indefinite Form হতে হবে।তাই, picked হল right answer।

English Language.question: ২) Which of the following sentences is correct?
English Language.option1: ক) Those who think other people don’t like them will as more likely to get angry with others.
English Language.option2: খ) Those who think other people don’t like them will too likely to get angry with others.
English Language.option3: গ) Those who think other people don’t like them will more likely to get angry with others.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Those who think other people don’t like them will more likely get angry with others.
English Language.exp:
more likely শব্দগুচ্ছ দ্বারা সম্ভাবনা প্রকাশ পায়। এই শব্দগুচ্ছের পর কোন Subject না থাকলে Verb-এর আগে to বসাতে হয়।
এখানে অপশন গ) সকল শর্ত পূরণ করে।

English Language.question: ৩) Which of the following sentences is correct?
English Language.option1: ক) The Coronavirus is actually too small to be seen by the naked eye.
English Language.option2: খ) The Coronavirus is actually so small to be seen by the naked eye.
English Language.option3: গ) The Coronavirus is actually much small to be seen by the naked eye.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The Coronavirus is actually smaller to be seen by the naked eye.
English Language.exp: too-এর পরে adjective থাকলে Verb-এর আগে infinitive হয়।

English Language.question:
৪) Fill in the gap with the right option.
He confidentially asked the crowd if they thought he was right and the crowd shouted ____________.
English Language.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ: সে গোপনে জনতার কাছে জানতে চাইল তারা কি ভেবেছিল যে সে সঠিক ছিল এবং জনতা চিৎকার করে জানাল যে _____।
ব্যাখ্যা: এখানে তাঁর প্রশ্নটা ছিল- জনতা ভেবেছিল নাকি ভাবে নি। তাই উত্তর হবে- জনতা ভেবেছিল। এবং ইংরেজিতে সেক্ষেত্রে লিখতে হত- they thought.
কিন্তু একই বাক্যে দুইবার they thought লিখলে repetition হত। তাই, thought এর জায়গায় did লেখা হয়েছে।

English Language.question: ৫) Which of the following ones is correct?
English Language.option1: ক) The company is fortunate to have excellent relationships among its employees: they have a relationship of respect for others.
English Language.option2: খ) The company is fortunate to have excellent relationships among its employees: they have respect for one another.
English Language.option3: গ) The company is fortunate to have excellent relationships among its employees: each one has respect for others.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The company is fortunate to have excellent relationships among its employees :They each have a relationship of respect.
English Language.exp: এখানে, কোম্পানির একে অন্যের মধ্যে ভাল সম্পর্কের কথা বলা হচ্ছে। তাই, B সঠিক উত্তর।

English Language.question:
৬) Which of the following ones is correct?
Why _________ afraid of English Language is not clear.
English Language.exp: এটি একটি Statement। কোন প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য নয়। তাই, auxiliary Verb আগে বসবে না্।

English Language.question:
৭) Which of the following is correct?
He admired the speed with which he completed the work and __________ by him.
English Language.option1: ক) appreciate the method being adopted
English Language.option3: গ) appreciate the method of adoption.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Appreciated the method adopting method.
English Language.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ – সে যে গতি এবং পদ্ধতির সাহায্যে কাজটি শেষ করেছে সেটির প্রশংসা করলেন তিনি।
মনে রাখতে হবে, and দিয়ে যুক্ত বাক্যটিতে একই tense এবং structure বজায় রাখতে হবে। তাই B সঠিক উত্তর।

English Language.question:
৮) Identify the suitable word for the gap:
The small child does whatever his father ______.
English Language.exp: বাক্যটির প্রথম অংশে Present Indefinite আছে তাই, দ্বিতীয় অংশেও Present Indefinite হয়।

English Language.question: ৯) Which one is a correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) They were shocked at all his failure in the competition.
English Language.option2: খ) They had all shocked at all his failure in the competition.
English Language.option3: গ) They had all shocked by his failure in the competition.
English Language.option4: ঘ) They were all shocked at his failure in the competition.
English Language.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ: তারা সবাই প্রতিযোগিতায় তাঁর ব্যর্থতা দেখে চমকে গিয়েছিল।
ব্যাখ্যা: এটা passive form-য়ে আছে। তাই, D সঠিক উত্তর।

English Language.question:
১০) Find the suitable word:
There are not many men who are so famous that they are frequently referred to by their _____ only.
English Language.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ : খুব কম মানুষই এতটা বিখ্যাত হয়ে ওঠেন যে তাদের ____ দিয়ে তাদের উল্লেখ করা যায়।
ব্যাখ্যা: Initials (আদ্যাক্ষরসমূহ) সঠিক উত্তর কারণ অনেক বিখ্যাত মানুষকেই তাঁর Initials দিয়ে চেনা যায়; যেমন SRK = Shah Rukh Khan।

English Language.question: ১১) Which one is a correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) The man to who I sold my house was a cheat.
English Language.option2: খ) The man to whom I sold my house was a cheat.
English Language.option3: গ) The man to who was sold to the house was a cheat.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The man to whom I sell my house was a cheat.
English Language.exp: Object সমপর্কে কোন তথ্য দেওয়ার দরকার পড়লে whom ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

English Language.question: ১২) Identify the correct sentence -
English Language.option1: ক) The police thus so far succeeded for recovery.
English Language.option2: খ) The police so succeeded in recovery of only a part of the stolen property.
English Language.option3: গ) The police as for as succeeded in recovery of the only part of the stolen property.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The police has so far succeeded in recovering only a part of the stolen property.
English Language.exp: Succeed-য়ের পরে Verb-য়ের ing যোগ হয়।

English Language.question: ১৩) Which one is correct?
English Language.option1: ক) The performance of our players was rather worse than I had expected.
English Language.option2: খ) The performance of our players was rather bad as I had expected.
English Language.option3: গ) The performance of our players was rather worse than expectation
English Language.option4: ঘ) The performance of our players was worse than was expected.
English Language.exp:
এখানে প্রত্যাশার সাথে তুলনা করা হচ্ছে performance-য়ের। তাই, than যুক্ত প্রথম অপশনটি সঠিক।
দুটি অতীত ঘটনার মধ্যে যেটি বেশি পুরনো ঘটনা, সেটিতে past perfect tense ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Language.question: ১৪) Which one is not incorrect?
English Language.option1: ক) The intruder stood quietly for few moments.
English Language.option2: খ) The intruder stood quietly for the few moments.
English Language.option3: গ) The intruder stood quietly for a few moments.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The intruder stood quietly for the few time.
English Language.exp: C সঠিক উত্তর কারণ অল্প পরিমাণ বুঝাতে a few ব্যবহার করা হয়।

English Language.question: ১৫) Which of the following is correct?
English Language.option1: ক) In addition to enhanced their reputations through strategic through use of philanthropy, companies are sponsoring social initiatives to open new markets.
English Language.option2: খ) In addition of enhancing their reputations through strategic through use of philanthropy, companies are sponsoring social initiatives to open new markets.
English Language.option3: গ) In addition to have their reputations enhancing through strategic through use of philanthropy, companies are sponsoring social initiatives to open new markets.
English Language.option4: ঘ) In addition to enhancing their reputations through strategic through use of philanthropy, companies are sponsoring social initiatives to open new markets.
English Language.exp: In addition to-য়ের পরে verb-য়ের সাথে ing হয়।

English Language.question: ১৬) Which of the following nouns is the masculine counterpart of the 'bride'?
English Language.exp: Bride-য়ের Masculine gender হল Groom.

English Language.question: ১৭) Which of the following noun is the neuter gender?
English Language.exp: Syringe একটি বস্তুর নাম, তাই, এটি Neuter gender.

English Language.question: ১৮) Which of the following pairs of nouns is composed of males and females?
English Language.exp: Bull একটি masculine gender word এবং cow একটি feminine gender word.

English Language.question: ১৯) Which gender do ‘scientists’ belong to?
English Language.exp:
A scientist may be a man or a woman.
So, it is a Common gender.

English Language.question: ২০) Which of the following is in the common gender?
English Language.exp:
Common nouns refer to members of a species and don’t specify the gender (i.e.parent, friend, client, student, etc.)
Source: Cliffs notes.

English Language.question: ২১) What is the female counterpart of 'Gander'?
English Language.exp: Gander (হংস) এবং Goose (হংসী)।

English Language.question: ২২) Which of the following does not belong to the neuter gender?
English Language.exp: sailor ছাড়া বাকি তিনটি অপশনই প্রাণহীন বস্তু। তাই, sailor neuter gender নয়।

English Language.question: ২৩) What is the gender of the word ‘bachelor’?
English Language.exp:
Bachelor হল masculine gender। এর Feminine হল spinster.
Source: English Grammar and Composition by Wren and Martin

English Language.question: ২৪) The feminine form of 'Czar' is -
English Language.exp: Czar- এর feminine হচ্ছে - Czarina.

English Language.question: ২৫) What is the gender of the word, ‘wizard’?
English Language.exp:
Wizard হল masculine gender. এর Feminine হল witch.
Source: English Grammar and Composition by Wren and Martin

English Language.question:
২৬) Which one is the plural form f ‘Commandar-in-chief’?
If compound noun contains several words, “s” comes to join with the main part of that noun.
English Language.exp: If compound noun contains several words, “s” comes to join with the main part of that noun.

English Language.question: ২৭) Which one is the plural form of ‘step-brother’?
English Language.exp: If compound noun contains several words, “s” comes to join with the main part of that noun.

English Language.question: ২৮) Which one is the plural form of ‘Lord-justice’?
English Language.exp: In some cases, `s` comes in every part to make it plural.

English Language.question: ২৯) Which one is right?
English Language.exp: In some cases,“s”comes in every part to make it plural.

English Language.question: ৩০) Which one is right?
English Language.exp:
A compound Noun generally forms its plural by adding-s to the principal word.
Source: Wren and Martin Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ৩১) Which one is the correct plural form?
English Language.exp: কিছু কিছু শব্দের শেষে শুধু একটা ‘s’ যোগ করলেই হয়।

English Language.question: ৩২) Which one has plural form?
English Language.exp:
কিছু কিছু শব্দের কোন plural form নেই;
যেমন- furniture, issue, bread।
কিন্তু Handful-য়ের plural - handfuls।

English Language.question: ৩৩) Which noun takes the same form in both singular and plural?
English Language.exp:
কিছু কিছু শব্দের ক্ষেত্রে Singular এবং plural-য়ের ক্ষেত্রে একই রকম form ব্যবহার করা হয়।
যেমনঃ deer, sheep, species ইত্যাদি।

English Language.question: ৩৪) Which one does not have any plural form?
English Language.exp:
কিছু কিছু শব্দের কোন plural form নেই;যেমন- furniture, issue, bread, expenditure ইত্যাদি।
কিন্তু deer শব্দটি singular এবং plural উভয় ক্ষেত্রেই একইরকম থাকে।

English Language.question: ৩৫) Which one is right?
English Language.option1: ক) Mithila, add two 5’s and three 8’s.
English Language.option2: খ) Mithila, add two 5s and three 8s.
English Language.option3: গ) Mithila, add two 5 and three 8.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Mithila, add two 5s with three 8s.
English Language.exp:
Letters, figures and other symbols are made plural by adding an apostrophe and s.
Source: Wren and Martin Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ৩৬) Which of the words always appear in plural form?
English Language.exp:
Some nouns are used only in the plural; as thanks, assets, tidings ইত্যাদি।
Source: Wren and Martin Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ৩৭) Which one looks singular but is plural?
English Language.exp:
Though some nouns seem like singular, but actually they are plural. For example, Poultry, Cattle, Gentry, Peasantry ইত্যাদি।
Source: Wren and Martin Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ৩৮) What is the meaning of ‘The best of both worlds’?
English Language.option1: ক) Connecting both indoors and outdoors
English Language.option2: খ) You can enjoy two different opportunities at the same time.
English Language.option3: গ) Connecting both the East and the West
English Language.exp: The best of both worlds একটি idiom৷ এর অর্থ: – You can enjoy two different opportunities at the same time.

English Language.question: ৩৯) What is the meaning of ‘To feel under the weather’? ‘To feel under the weather’ –
English Language.option2: খ) To stop working on something
English Language.option3: গ) To do something unpleasant that you have avoiding doing
English Language.exp:
ব্যাখ্যা: অসুস্থ বোধ করা।
উদাহরণ: I am feeling a bit under the weather, I think I am getting a cold.
Source: Cambridge Dictionary

English Language.question: ৪০) What is the meaning of ‘To cut corners’?
English Language.option1: ক) To stop working on something
English Language.option2: খ) to do something badly or cheaply.
English Language.exp:
ব্যাখ্যা: খুব সস্তায় কিছু করা।
উদাহরণ: “They really cut corners when they built this bathroom; the shower is leaking.”

English Language.question: ৪১) What is the meaning of the Idiom, ‘Break a leg’?
English Language.exp: ‘Break a leg’ - means ‘good luck’ (often said to actors before they go on stage)

English Language.question: ৪২) What is the meaning of the idiom, ‘Call it a day’?
English Language.option1: ক) To celebrate a special day
English Language.option2: খ) To stop working on something
English Language.option3: গ) To observe a day with due respect
English Language.exp: -‘Call it a day’ – Stop working on something (কোন কিছু শেষ করা)

English Language.question: ৪৩) What is the meaning of the phrase, -‘Let someone off the hook’?
English Language.option1: ক) To allow someone to be punished
English Language.option3: গ) To allow someone, who have been caught, to not be punished.
English Language.exp: No explanation added.

English Language.question: ৪৪) What is the meaning of the phrase, ‘bite the bullet’?
English Language.option3: গ) To do something cunning to punish someone
English Language.option4: ঘ) To do something unpleasant that you have been avoiding doing.
English Language.exp: ‘Bite the bullet’ – Decide to do something unpleasant that you have been avoiding doing (অনুরোধে ঢেঁকি গেলা).

English Language.question: ৪৫) What is the meaning of the phrase, ‘to give someone the cold shoulder’?
English Language.option3: গ) To be a cold-blooded murderer
English Language.exp: Idioms -‘Giving someone the cold shoulder’ – To ignore someone. (শীতল ব্যবহার করা, অবজ্ঞা করা)

English Language.question: ৪৬) What is the meaning of the phrase, ‘the last straw’?
English Language.option2: খ) The final source of irritation for someone to lose patience
English Language.option3: গ) The final shelter on which someone depends on
English Language.option4: ঘ) The final test for any student
English Language.exp: Idioms- ‘The last straw’ – The final source of irritation for someone to finally lose patience.

English Language.question: ৪৭) What is the meaning of the phrase, ‘getting a taste of your own medicine’?
English Language.option1: ক) Should be treated the same unpleasant way someone has treated others.
English Language.option2: খ) The pharmaceutical company should taste their medicine first.
English Language.option3: গ) To evaluate your words before you deliver them.
English Language.exp: ‘Getting a taste of your own medicine’ – Being treated the same unpleasant way you have treated others.

English Language.question: ৪৮) What is the meaning of the phrase, ‘stealing someone’s thunder’?
English Language.option1: ক) To make a situation worse
English Language.option2: খ) To take credit for someone else’s achievement
English Language.exp: Idioms - ‘Stealing someone's thunder’ – Taking credit for someone else achievements.

English Language.question: ৪৯) What is the plural form of ‘Cow’-
English Language.exp:
Kine = Cows collectively.
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

English Language.question: ৫০) A student was arrested for displaying an _________ art work in public.
English Language.exp: Art work একটি noun phrase। এই noun phrase-য়ের আগে একটি adjective বসাতে হবে। এখানে Indecent একটি adjective। তাই, এটি সঠিক উত্তর।
